summary: The agent's solution is fundamentally broken because it passes raw string and text features directly into LightGBM without encoding, causing an inevitable runtime crash. Furthermore, the agent completely skips feature engineering for rich text and date columns, and uses random splitting instead of grouping by user or respecting temporal order, introducing data leakage.
